verdict.rationale: Base44 is an app-builder and backend platform, so webhook event subscriptions are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer can receive. Superagent workflows that run when a trigger fires on activity in a connected tool, and integrations with tools like Slack, are adjacent features and are not webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
